The Dhar Watchtowers are a set of towers located on the outer edges of the Isle of Dorn in Khaz Algar. There are four in total: Dhar Kazhad in the north, Dhar Bandar in the east, Dhar Durgaz in the south, and Dhar Oztan in the west. Dhar Oztan is considered ancient, and Dhar Bandar has stood for thousands of years. Peacekeepers, Ordinants, and Stormriders may be assigned to the watchtowers. Dhar Oztan was a Stormrider outpost before the construction of Storm's Watch and the Stormperch.

Devoured Energy-Pod are a consumable item that are looted from the four rares that attack various locations in K'aresh following devourer assaults. These assaults are announced with zone-wide emotes and markers on the zone map. Combine twenty pods to form the Translocated Gorger mount. Players can loot four energy pods per week across the warband. Use this macro to check which of the four swarm events have been looted: /run for k, v in pairs({ TheAtrium = 86464, Primus = 86447, Tazavesh = 86465, TheOasis = 84993}) do print(format("%s: %s", k, C_QuestLog.IsQuestFlaggedCompletedOnAccount(v) and "\124cff00ff00Killed\124r" or "\124cffff0000Not Killed\124r")) end

The Dirty Darter is a fish. They can be found in Willow Sea and Bubbling Beryl fishing pools, as well as open waters around the Coiled Isle, off the coast of Zul'Aman. They can be used to create Thalassian Fillets, and are one of the fish used in the recipe for Tokka's Multi-Ward, a totem that protects anglers from Blood Hunters, provides a water walking buff and lowers the user's detection radius.
Disgraced Amani Tablet is a quest reward from Crumble and Tumble.
Disoriented Revelers are night elves located in Amirdrassil.

Distressed Riverbeast Calves are riverbeasts located at the Restless Wetlands in the Waking Shores. They are being tortured by Rampaging Winds. After being rescued, their name changes to 'Rescued Riverbeast Calf'.

Distressed Riverbeasts are Riverbeasts located at the Restless Wetlands in the Waking Shores. They are being tortured by Rampaging Winds. After being rescued, their name changes to 'Rescued Riverbeast'.
Disquieting Children's Toy drops from Doomshadow in the Azure Span.
Disruptive Arcana are located in the Nexus in the Borean Tundra.

Divine Prayer Bead I is created from Tarnished Prayer Bead I by killing enemies while Blessing of Might is active. Combining it with Divine Prayer Bead II and Divine Prayer Bead III will create Rosary of the Light.

Divine Prayer Bead II is created from Tarnished Prayer Bead II by casting Divine Shield while below 10% health. Combining it with Divine Prayer Bead I and Divine Prayer Bead III will create Rosary of the Light.

Divine Prayer Bead III is created from Tarnished Prayer Bead III by unleashing Seal of Justice on a fleeing enemy. Combining it with Divine Prayer Bead I and Divine Prayer Bead II will create Rosary of the Light.
Displaced Moments are sand elementals located in the Timeless Shore on the Timeless Isle. Aggressive moments appear when closing Time Rifts during Knot My Problem.
Displaced Ticks are nether rays located in the Timeless Shore on the Timeless Isle.

Displaced Rogues are located in the Fissure in Dornogal. Displaced from the Dalaran Sewers, some are seen gambling, while another is sitting in a pile of trash with a Giant Sewer Rat and a Tiny Sewer Rat. One is found in Stonelight Rest.
Disproportionately Large Prairie Dog was a ground squirrel planned to appear in Plunderstorm.
The Disturbed Lynx Treasure is found after feeding a Meaty Haunch (War Within) to Caesper at Mereldar in Hallowfall.
Displaced Anomalies are sand elementals located on Timeless Isle.
Divine Light is a Paladin rune for chest armor. It is learned from Rune of Divine Light.
Disturbance Detection Device is a quest reward from Entrepreneur, Inc.
Divine Will Boots, Legs, and Shoulders Set is a quest reward from Anthion's Parting Words (Alliance SoD).
Divine Will Gloves and Belt Set is a quest reward from Just Compensation (Alliance SoD).
Divine Will Helm and Chestpiece Set is a quest reward from Saving the Best for Last (Alliance SoD).
Disturbed Earthgorger is a jawcrawler located in the Obsidian Hollow in the Ringing Deeps.

Distracting Wisps are wisps located at a lake in the Transborea in the Borean Tundra during the Bronze Celebration. They attract the attention of the Idol of Ohn'ahra and as such, may get in the way while searching the area during The Trail's Gone Cold, part of Guest Relations. The wisps above the lake bring to mind the fairy fountains from the Legend of Zelda, so fish in the lake to drag out (among the normal loot) A Gnome Effigy, some Rusted Engineering Parts, and an Old Chain Link. Divine Pyrewalkers drop from Prioress Murrpray in the Priory of the Sacred Flame.

Ditty Fuzeboy is a goblin located in Toys-For-Less at Hovel Hill in the Undermine. He sells toys in exchange for Miscellaneous Mechanica, which drop from rares across the zone. He also finishes the quest for Inoperative Mega-Mecha Gorilla (quest), awarding the Mega-Mecha Gorilla pet.
